header.source: three rows of batch-01.json — one full, one meaning only, one empty

rows.definition: A primer of the alphabet — the letters gathered first, so everything spelled later can be read. An abecedary holds no sentences; it holds what sentences are made of.
rows.sanctuary_meaning: The collection that holds the elements before anything is built from them. An abecedary here is the ordered primer of a vocabulary — the pieces gathered and kept in order, so that whatever is spelled from them can be read.
rows.historical_meaning: Late Latin abecedarium, a table of the alphabet named by sounding its first four letters — a, be, ce, de — where an abecedarius was one still learning them; the sense travelled from the alphabet table itself to any primer setting out the elements of a subject in order.

rows.definition: The Android debug bridge's command name — the wire between a dev machine and a device, spoken lowercase in the shell.
rows.sanctuary_meaning: The wire to a real device. It is how a build leaves the workbench and is installed, driven and read back on hardware rather than on an emulator.

rows.definition: A compound fragment from this library's own naming, not an English word. Flagged for the mis-cut band rather than defined.
